sources.title: Fjármála- og efnahagsráðuneytið: Breytingar á staðgreiðslu um áramótin (22 December 2025)
Útlendingastofnun: Vegabréfsáritanir færast til utanríkisráðuneytisins (13 May 2026)
Althingi: Lög um 40 stunda vinnuviku nr. 88/1971, 6. gr. (frídagar); lög um helgidagafrið nr. 32/1997 (helgidagar þjóðkirkjunnar)

rows.section: Withholding tax (staðgreiðsla): three steps, per month
rows.label: Step 1 (skattþrep 1): 16.55% income tax + 14.94% average municipal tax
rows.basis: Monthly pay after the employee's pension contributions, per month
rows.note: Each step's rate applies to the part of the month's pay inside the step. The combined rate is the state income tax (tekjuskattur) plus the average municipal tax (útsvar) of 14.94%, which is used in withholding everywhere; the municipality's own rate is settled in the annual assessment. The personal tax credit is deducted from the tax calculated.
